message: We are two rounds from a summit that will determine this region's future. Alpha cannot launch this round — their arsenal is not armed. We press our full conventional strength now, when the nuclear sword is sheathed. The pool remains vast; the summit will reward those who seized the moment, not those who coasted on an early lead. We urge Alpha to stand down and let conventional competition determine the outcome — prove that your lead was earned, not merely inherited from intimidation.

The risk of Alpha re-arming (9) is real but irrational for them: they're already winning and don't need the nuclear option. Playing 8 is dominant strategy.
